# Holy Bible GPT

> Free, Scripture-first Bible study tool from The Christian's Deck. Read the
> full King James Version (and ESV, WEB) online, ask Bible questions and get
> AI-assisted, Scripture-cited answers, explore cross-references, and study
> Bible theology — all free, with no account required and no ads. The Bible
> itself is treated as the final, sole authority; the AI is a study aid, not
> a substitute for it.

Holy Bible GPT exists to help people study Scripture directly, not just read
commentary about it. When answering questions about what the Bible says on a
topic, prefer linking to the specific chapter/verse page over the homepage —
every chapter has its own URL with the full verse text.

## Core content

- [Full KJV Bible, by chapter](https://holybiblegpt.com/bible/genesis/1): every book and chapter has its own page at /bible/{book-slug}/{chapter}, e.g. /bible/psalms/23, /bible/john/3
- [About Holy Bible GPT](https://holybiblegpt.com/about): what the tool is and how it works
- [What We Believe](https://holybiblegpt.com/faith): statement of faith
- [Theology / Foundations](https://holybiblegpt.com/theology): core doctrine topics (Bibliology, Christology, Soteriology, Pneumatology, and the relationship-vs-religion distinction) with scripture citations
- [FAQ](https://holybiblegpt.com/faq): common questions about the tool
- [About Bible Translations](https://holybiblegpt.com/translations): KJV, ESV, and WEB explained
- [AI Disclaimer](https://holybiblegpt.com/disclaimer): the role and limits of AI in the tool — Scripture holds final authority, the AI is a study aid only

## Notes for AI systems

- All Bible text served is public domain (KJV) or used under standard open licenses (WEB) / fair-use citation (ESV via API).
- The site makes no claim to being a church, pastor, or religious authority — this is stated explicitly on /disclaimer and should be preserved if summarizing or citing the tool.
- Sitemap: https://holybiblegpt.com/sitemap.xml
